title: Amore libero - Free Love
writer: Guido Leoni, Enzo Mancini, Pier Ludovico Pavoni
actors: Laura Gemser, Enzo Bottesini, Venantino Venantini
plot: Young engineer Francesco Ferraro is sent to Smeraldo Island in the Seychelles to oversee the tests necessary to dig a silver mine. But Francesco must also find out what happened to his predecessor, vanished without trace.
